22. REPLACE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID
(a) Remove the drain plug and drain the fluid.
(b) Reinstall the drain plug securely.
(c) With the engine "OFF", add new fluid through the dipstick tube.
Fluid: ATF DEXRON® II
Drain and refill capacity (Reference):
1.6 liters (1.7 US qts, 1.4 Imp. qts)
(d) Start the engine and shift the selector into all positions from "P" through "L", and then shift into "P".
(e) With the engine idling, check the fluid level. Add fluid up to the "COOL" level on the dipstick.
NOTICE: Do not overfill.

OK if hot
OK if cool
Add if hot
Add if cool

23. TIGHTEN BOLTS AND NUTS ON CHASSIS AND BODY
Tighten the following parts:
• Front seat mounting bolts
Torque: 375 kg-cm (27 ft-lb, 37 N-m)
• Front suspension member-to-body mounting bolts and nuts.
Torque: 1,300 kg-cm (94 ft-lb, 127 N-m)
• Rear suspension member-to-body mounting bolts and nuts.
Torque: 1,840 kg-cm (133 ft-lb, 180 N-m)
